Before proceeding, may I kindly confirm whether you will be complete the following payments:

September: Payment for the remaining 8 nights
October: Full monthly rent
May: Final month’s rent
Security deposit: As applicable

Please also note that if you decide to cancel the booking at any point during the agreed stay period, the final month’s payment will be non-refundable, as the apartment will be blocked and reserved exclusively for you for the entire period.

Kindly confirm so we can proceed accordingly.
